hooks.command: cmd="$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')"; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -q 'git commit'; then cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && perl -i -pe 'BEGIN{chomp($d=`date +%F`)} s/updated on: \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/updated on: $d/' templates/base.html && git add templates/base.html; fi 2>/dev/null; true
